back: A systematic process of finding and fixing the cause of a fault, simplest causes first.
Regular tasks that stop faults happening: cleaning, updates, antivirus, backups, surge protection.
Static electricity jumping to a component and damaging it; prevented by an anti-static wrist strap.
Switch off and unplug; anti-static strap; hold parts by the edges; never open the PSU or monitor.
Identify → check simple causes → test one change at a time → fix → test → record.
Beeps at start-up, no boot, random crashes → reseat, test in another slot or with a known good module, replace.
Clicking, slow, corrupted files → back up immediately, run a disk check, replace and restore.
Check cable/batteries, clean, check layout setting or surface, try another port, replace.
CPU → cooler → RAM → motherboard into case → PSU → drives → expansion cards → cables → close → test.
